items.title: The Los Angeles Clippers are waiving Cam Christie, league sources told HoopsHype. Christie had a $2.30 million salary guarantee date that was approaching. Christie, who recently turned 21, was the 46th pick of the 2024 NBA Draft and spent the past two seasons with the Clippers.
